spotlight.title: Apollo 11: Catching Some Sun
spotlight.summary: Bright sunlight glints as long dark shadows mark this image of the surface of the Moon. It was taken on July 20, 1969, by Apollo 11 astronaut Neil Armstrong, the first to walk on the lunar surface.
